items.markdown:
Effective hair regrowth for men `relies primarily on two FDA-approved medications that target the root causes of male pattern baldness (androgenic alopecia)`:[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/treating-hair-loss-in-men-what-works)[[2]](https://www.hims.com/hair-loss)

### FDA-Approved Treatments

- **Minoxidil (Over-the-Counter):** Available as a 5% foam or liquid (such as [ROGAINE®](https://www.rogaine.com/collections/mens-products) ) applied directly to the scalp. It widens blood vessels, increases blood flow to the follicles, and extends the hair growth phase. Results typically appear in 2 to 6 months.[[1]](https://www.rogaine.com/collections/mens-products)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/treating-hair-loss-in-men-what-works)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/19xEu7ud6bI)
- **Finasteride (Prescription):** Taken as a daily oral pill, it blocks the conversion of testosterone into dihydrotestosterone (DHT), the hormone responsible for shrinking hair follicles. Clinical reviews show it is often slightly more effective than minoxidil at slowing or reversing thinning.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/hair-loss)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/treating-hair-loss-in-men-what-works)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/bernstein.medical.hair.restoration/videos/minoxidil-better-known-as-rogaine-and-finasteride-commonly-known-as-propecia-are/1466887690682126/)

### Other Medical and Surgical Options

- **Hair Transplants:** A surgical procedure where a specialist moves healthy hair follicles from the back or sides of the head to thinning or bald areas.[[1]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24515-male-pattern-baldness-androgenic-alopecia)
- **Low-Level Laser/Light Therapy:** FDA-approved laser devices or combs can help stimulate dormant follicles and improve scalp circulation.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYMRSfjlL9q/)[[2]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)
- **Combination Telehealth Kits:** Platforms like [Hims](https://www.hims.com/hair-loss) or dermatologist-guided programs combine topical or oral solutions with tailored support.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/hair-loss)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:12056652461806327840,catalogid:2793567527683979867,gpcid:17784756244511311950&ibp=oshop)

### Important Guidelines

- **Consistency is mandatory:** Both minoxidil and finasteride must be used continuously; stopping treatment causes any regrown hair to shed within a few months.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/treating-hair-loss-in-men-what-works)[[2]](https://www.rogaine.com/collections/mens-products)
- **Early action works best:** Treatment is far more effective when started at the first signs of thinning before follicles permanently miniaturize.[[1]](https://www.cvs.com/learn/health/mens-health/hair-regrowth-for-men)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/19xEu7ud6bI)

If you want to narrow down the best path, tell me:

- What **stage of hair thinning** or recession are you noticing?
- Are you open to a **daily pill** or prefer a **topical treatment**?
